caveats: SYNTHETIC: no time series. volumes{} empty and periods[] empty by design; the game must use an illustrative covariance and show the 'Illustrative network - not measured' badge (brief 5.4).
meanShare is a share of US import VALUE; mixes BIS 2021 (sintered NdFeB only), Comtrade 2025 (four partners only) and assumptions (VNM, other).
HS 850511 includes non-rare-earth metal magnets (e.g. fridge magnets seen in Sayari rows) and Dy content per magnet varies, so magnet value is a weak proxy for Dy.
All tier-2 shares are assumed (general knowledge), including the 1:1 contained-element ratio.
Ownership links for DMEGC VN and the Shin-Etsu units are inferred from names or trade edges; Sayari returned no beneficial-owner rows for them.
Sayari supplier rows for China/Germany show latest_shipment_date 2020, so the named companies show who has shipped, not current volume.
280530 and 284690 were not pulled from Sayari for this file; their annual Comtrade values remain in trade.json.
